nonBlockingObservations.detail: The native input and rich business text share one inline line and touch at the boundary at desktop width. All glyphs and field borders remain visible; mobile/tablet naturally wrap the field onto its own line. Recorded as visible slot layout rather than a confirmed component defect.

A 4x nearest-neighbor detail view confirms the visible loading mark is a small blue arc, with no text obstruction. The marker differs from a normal hollow dot as expected for loading; no animation claim is made from a static PNG.
